about: Drafted UG role roadmaps for dropdown roles no Word-file batch covers. Written with AI assistance from OneGrasp's existing roadmaps; awaiting expert review. Each entry names its sheet row (Roles_Flat_Classified #); degree, course and role come from that row. Expanded by scripts/ug_drafted_roadmaps.py.

roadmaps.overview: A Fab Engineer keeps a semiconductor fabrication line running: the process steps (lithography, etch, deposition, implant, CMP) that turn silicon wafers into chips, with high yield and tight control. India's new fabs and the India Semiconductor Mission are creating these roles at home for the first time.
duties: Monitor and tune one or more process steps so wafers stay within specification
Analyse yield and defect data and find the root cause of excursions
Run equipment qualifications, recipes and preventive-maintenance checks with vendors
Write process documentation and work to cleanroom, safety and contamination rules
workplaces: Semiconductor fabs and pilot lines (e.g. Tata Electronics Dholera, SCL Mohali)
plan: Master semiconductor physics basics: band theory, doping, p-n junctions
Learn Python or MATLAB for data handling
Read about how a chip is made, step by step
Study MOSFETs, CMOS and process flows (oxidation, lithography, etch, deposition)
Learn statistics and statistical process control (SPC)
Visit or take an online lab course at a nanofabrication facility
Do a project on yield, defect analysis or a simulated process flow (TCAD)
Learn design of experiments (DoE) and Six Sigma basics
Intern at a fab, OSAT or equipment company
Pick a module (litho, etch, thin film, metrology) and go deep
Final-year project with measurable process data
Prepare for campus hiring and GATE if you want an M.Tech
certifications: Courses under the India Semiconductor Mission / C2S programme
higher: MS in Electrical or Materials Engineering abroad
abroad: MS in Taiwan, Singapore, South Korea, the US or Europe, where most fabs are
Fab roles in those countries after the MS

roadmaps.overview: An IoT Agri Solutions Engineer designs and deploys sensor systems for farms: soil-moisture probes, weather stations, smart irrigation controllers and the dashboards farmers use to decide when to water, spray or harvest.
duties: Choose sensors, controllers and networks (LoRa, GSM, Wi-Fi) for a farm's needs
Build and install devices, then keep them working in the field
Turn the readings into alerts and simple advice for farmers
Work with agronomists to check that the system really saves water or improves yield
workplaces: Government digital agriculture and smart-village schemes
plan: Learn agricultural engineering fundamentals: soil, water, crops
Build a first Arduino soil-moisture sensor
Study irrigation engineering and drip/sprinkler design
Learn microcontrollers (ESP32), MQTT and cloud dashboards
Collect a season of real field data and analyse it
Build a full system: sensors + gateway + dashboard + alerts
Learn GIS (QGIS) and remote sensing basics
Intern with an agri-tech or irrigation company
Final project deployed on a real farm, with water or yield results
Learn device power, weatherproofing and maintenance
Build a portfolio and apply to agri-tech firms
internships: Krishi Vigyan Kendras or university research farms
certifications: NPTEL courses on IoT and precision agriculture
DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (for farm drones)
higher: M.Tech Agricultural Engineering / Soil and Water Engineering
M.Tech or MS in IoT / Embedded Systems
abroad: MS in Agricultural or Biosystems Engineering (Netherlands, Israel, US, Australia)

roadmaps.overview: A Genetic Counsellor helps patients and families understand genetic test results and inherited conditions, and what they mean for health, pregnancy and family planning. The role needs a postgraduate degree in genetic counselling; a B.Sc in Genetics is the starting point.
duties: Take family histories and assess the risk of inherited conditions
Explain genetic tests and their results in plain language
Support families emotionally through difficult decisions
Work with doctors, labs and fertility or cancer teams
plan: Master Mendelian genetics, cell biology and biochemistry
Read real case stories of genetic conditions
Improve spoken English and one regional language for counselling
Study human genetics, cytogenetics and molecular diagnostics
Learn to draw and read pedigrees
Volunteer with a hospital, NGO or patient-support group
Do a project in a diagnostics or research lab
Learn basic counselling and communication skills (short course)
Apply for M.Sc Genetic Counselling / Medical Genetics
roadmaps.plan_note: You can work as a genetic counsellor only after a PG in genetic counselling with supervised clinical training.

technical: Understanding test reports (karyotype, NGS, prenatal screening)

certifications: Board certification in genetic counselling, once eligible (check the current Indian certifying body)
exams: University entrance tests for M.Sc (e.g. CUET-PG)
abroad: MS in Genetic Counseling (US, UK, Canada, Australia); certification there follows their own boards
roadmaps.note: Genetic counselling is a clinical role: a B.Sc alone is not enough to counsel patients.

roadmaps.overview: A Data Curator in bioinformatics collects, checks and organises biological data (genes, proteins, variants, experiments) so scientists can trust and reuse it. It suits careful, detail-minded students who like both biology and data.
duties: Extract data from papers and experiments into structured databases
Check records for errors and apply standard vocabularies (ontologies)
Write metadata so others can find and reuse datasets
Work with scientists and developers to improve databases
workplaces: Biological data centres (e.g. Indian Biological Data Centre)
plan: Learn molecular biology, genetics and biochemistry
Explore NCBI, UniProt and Ensembl databases
Learn SQL and data cleaning in Python/R
Study ontologies (Gene Ontology) and metadata standards
Curate a small dataset from published papers
Project with a lab or data centre curating a real dataset
Learn FAIR data principles and version control (Git)
Build a portfolio of curated datasets and scripts
internships: Indian Biological Data Centre or bioinformatics institutes

roadmaps.overview: A Geoscientist studies rocks, minerals, groundwater and the Earth's structure to find resources and understand hazards. Government geoscientist posts at GSI, ONGC and similar bodies need a postgraduate degree; a B.Sc in Geology is the first step.
duties: Map rocks and structures in the field
Analyse samples, cores and geophysical data
Assess mineral, oil, gas or groundwater potential
workplaces: ONGC, Oil India and mining companies
Central Ground Water Board and state geology departments
Consultancies for mining, tunnels and dams
plan: Learn mineralogy, petrology and physical geology
Go on every field trip and keep a field notebook
Learn map reading and basic GIS
Study structural geology, stratigraphy and palaeontology
Learn QGIS and basic remote sensing
Attend a field camp and practise geological mapping
Prepare for the PG and exams
Do a project with field data or a lab analysis
Start preparing for the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist exam syllabus
Apply for M.Sc Geology / Applied Geology
roadmaps.plan_note: GSI, CGWB and similar posts are filled through the UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, which needs a PG. ONGC recruits geoscientists through GATE (GG).
internships: GSI or state geology department summer training
certifications: GIS / remote sensing courses (IIRS Dehradun online courses)
NPTEL courses in geology and geophysics
abroad: MSc in Petroleum Geoscience or Mining Geology (UK, Australia, Canada)
roadmaps.note: Check the UPSC notification each year for the exact qualifying degrees and age limits.

roadmaps.overview: A Meteorologist studies the atmosphere to forecast weather and understand climate, from daily forecasts to cyclone warnings. Scientist posts at the India Meteorological Department (IMD) need a postgraduate degree; a B.Sc in Meteorology / Atmospheric Science is the base.
duties: Analyse observations from stations, radars and satellites
Run and interpret numerical weather prediction models
Issue forecasts and warnings for public, aviation, farming and shipping
Study climate trends and extreme weather
workplaces: IITM Pune, NCMRWF and other research institutes
Airports, ports and the armed forces' weather services
plan: Physics and maths for the atmosphere
Follow IMD's daily weather and cyclone bulletins
Learn to read weather maps, satellite and radar images
Work with real station data in Python
Forecasting and prepare for the PG
Project on monsoon, rainfall or a past cyclone using real data
Try running a simple weather model (WRF) with guidance
Apply for M.Sc / M.Tech in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
roadmaps.plan_note: IMD Scientist posts need a PG; the SSC Scientific Assistant (IMD) exam is an entry route with a B.Sc in Physics/related subjects.
certifications: WMO and NPTEL courses in meteorology
exams: CSIR-NET (Earth, Atmospheric, Ocean and Planetary Sciences)
abroad: MS in Atmospheric Science (US, UK, Germany)
progression: Scientist E-F / Head of a forecasting centre

roadmaps.overview: A Junior Robotics Programmer writes the software that makes robots and automated machines move, sense and decide, from warehouse robots to factory arms and educational robots.
duties: Program robot motion, sensors and simple behaviours
Test and debug code on simulators and real robots
Document code and support senior engineers on projects
plan: Build Arduino projects with motors and sensors
Learn ROS 2 basics and a simulator (Gazebo)
Build a line-following or obstacle-avoiding robot
Add computer vision with OpenCV to a robot project
Intern with a robotics or automation company
Publish your projects with videos on GitHub
higher: MCA / M.Sc in AI or Robotics
PG Diploma in Robotics and Automation
abroad: MS in Robotics / Mechatronics (Germany, US) - may need bridging courses after BCA

roadmaps.overview: A Junior Dealer executes buy and sell orders in shares, derivatives, currencies or commodities for a broking firm's clients or its own book, quickly and within strict risk limits.
duties: Place and track orders on the trading terminal
Follow client instructions and the firm's risk limits
Watch markets and news that move prices
Reconcile trades and report positions at day end
plan: Learn how stock exchanges, orders and settlement work
Paper-trade and keep a trading journal
Clear the NISM certifications for dealers
Learn technical and fundamental analysis basics
Intern at a broking firm or dealing desk
Learn risk management and SEBI rules for brokers
Apply for dealer and back-office trading roles
tools: Exchange trading terminals (NSE NOW, ODIN and similar)
certifications: NISM Series VII - Securities Operations and Risk Management
NISM Series I / XVI for currency / commodity derivatives
roadmaps.note: Never trade with borrowed money while learning; SEBI data show most individual derivatives traders lose money.

roadmaps.overview: A Payments Executive runs and improves digital payment operations - UPI, cards, wallets, NEFT/RTGS - at a bank or fintech, making sure money moves correctly, safely and on time.
duties: Handle failed transactions, refunds and disputes
Reconcile payments with bank and partner records
Help launch payment products with tech and compliance teams
plan: Learn accounting and how banks work
Understand UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and cards
Study RBI rules for payments and KYC
Intern in a fintech or bank operations team
Do a project analysing failed or fraudulent transactions
exams: IBPS / SBI exams for banking jobs

roadmaps.overview: An Investment Advisor helps people plan their money - goals, risk, mutual funds, shares, insurance and retirement - and recommends what suits them. In India, giving paid investment advice needs SEBI registration as an Investment Adviser (RIA).
duties: Understand a client's goals, income and risk appetite
Build and review a financial plan and portfolio
Explain products honestly, including costs and risks
Keep records and follow SEBI's adviser rules
plan: Learn accounting, economics and personal finance
Track your own budget and a model portfolio
Read about how mutual funds and shares work
Study mutual funds, equity, bonds, insurance and tax
Intern with an advisory or wealth firm
Prepare sample financial plans for real families (with permission)
certifications: NISM Series X-A and X-B (Investment Adviser)
roadmaps.note: SEBI sets the qualification and registration rules for Investment Advisers - check its current requirements before you apply.

roadmaps.overview: A Wealth Associate supports relationship managers in serving wealthy clients: preparing portfolio reviews, processing transactions and researching products.
duties: Prepare client portfolio reports and reviews
Research mutual funds, bonds and other products
Keep client records and compliance papers up to date
plan: Study mutual funds, bonds, insurance and tax
Clear NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors)
Intern in a wealth firm or bank
Build a sample client review deck

roadmaps.overview: An Equity Analyst studies companies and industries to judge whether their shares are worth buying, holding or selling, and writes research reports for investors or fund managers.
plan: Read annual reports of companies you know
Learn ratio analysis, financial modelling and DCF valuation
Write your first stock research note
Start CFA Level I preparation if aiming high
Publish 3-5 research notes as a portfolio

roadmaps.overview: A Mutual Fund Distributor helps investors choose and invest in mutual fund schemes, and earns commission from the fund houses. You need the NISM Series V-A certificate and an ARN registration with AMFI.
duties: Explain mutual fund types, risks and costs to investors
Help investors start SIPs and lump-sum investments
plan: Learn how mutual funds, SIPs and NAV work
Start your own small SIP and track it
Apply for an ARN with AMFI
Learn KYC and online distribution platforms
Start advising family and friends under your ARN
Intern or work part-time with a distributor
tools: MF Utility / BSE StAR MF / NSE NMF
certifications: NISM Series V-B (for a limited distributor role)
abroad: Not usually needed for this role
roadmaps.note: A distributor may not charge fees for advice; paid advice needs SEBI RIA registration.

roadmaps.overview: A Property Analyst studies real-estate markets and projects - prices, rents, demand and costs - to help developers, investors and lenders decide what to build, buy or lend on.
duties: Collect and analyse property prices, rents and supply data
Build financial models for projects (cash flows, IRR)
Prepare market reports and feasibility studies
Track RERA filings, regulations and infrastructure plans
plan: Understand how property is bought, built and sold in India
Study real-estate finance, valuation and RERA
Analyse prices in one city area using public data
Learn basic GIS and Power BI
Intern with a consultancy or developer
Build a full feasibility study for a sample project
Apply for research and analyst roles
higher: MBA Real Estate (e.g. RICS School of Built Environment)
PG Diploma in Real Estate Management

roadmaps.overview: A Site Admin runs the administration of a construction site: labour records, materials, stores, documents, safety paperwork and coordination with the head office, so engineers can focus on building.
duties: Maintain labour attendance, payroll inputs and contractor records
Track material receipts, stores and stock
Handle site documents, permits and compliance registers
plan: Visit construction sites to see how they run
Study construction materials, stores and procurement
Learn labour laws (BOCW Act, contract labour) and safety basics
Learn an ERP or inventory tool
Intern at a construction site office
Prepare sample site registers and reports
Apply for site admin and stores roles
abroad: Site admin roles in the Gulf construction sector

roadmaps.overview: A Cooperative Officer helps run and supervise cooperative societies - dairy, credit, marketing or housing - that are owned by their members. They work for state cooperative departments, cooperative banks or federations.
duties: Register, inspect and audit cooperative societies
Guide societies on rules, elections and accounts
Support members' training and business plans
workplaces: Dairy and marketing federations (e.g. Amul-type unions)
plan: Learn accounting, economics and rural sociology
Visit a dairy or credit cooperative
Study cooperative law and your state's Cooperative Societies Act
Follow the Ministry of Cooperation's schemes
Intern with a cooperative bank or federation
Do a project on one society's working
Prepare for state PSC cooperative posts
certifications: Courses at VAMNICOM Pune or state cooperative training institutes
abroad: Rarely needed; international cooperative alliance programmes exist

roadmaps.overview: A Rural Marketing Executive plans and runs campaigns that bring products - FMCG, agri-inputs, two-wheelers, phones - to villages and small towns, adapting the message, price and distribution to rural customers.
duties: Plan rural campaigns: haats, melas, van campaigns, demos
Build and manage rural distributors and retailers
plan: Learn marketing principles and rural economics
Spend time in a village market and note what sells
Study rural consumer behaviour and distribution
Learn basic market research and Excel
Plan a sample campaign for one product
Intern with an FMCG or agri-input company
Apply for rural sales and marketing roles

roadmaps.overview: A Micro-finance Officer gives and recovers small loans to low-income borrowers - usually women's groups in villages and towns - and helps them use credit well. It is a field role with microfinance institutions and small finance banks.
duties: Check borrowers' eligibility and complete KYC
Guide borrowers on responsible borrowing and savings
plan: Learn accounting, banking and rural economics
Study RBI's microfinance rules and fair-practice code
Learn credit appraisal for small loans
Learn mobile banking apps used in the field
Intern with an MFI or small finance bank
Do a project on SHG repayment or financial literacy

roadmaps.overview: An ESG Analyst measures how companies perform on environmental, social and governance issues - emissions, workers, boards, ethics - so investors and companies can manage risks and report honestly. SEBI's BRSR rules have made this a growing role in India.
duties: Collect and analyse companies' ESG data and disclosures
Prepare ESG scores, reports and BRSR inputs
Track regulations and frameworks (BRSR, GRI, ISSB)
Advise on risks and improvement plans
plan: Learn accounting, economics and environmental studies
Study BRSR, GRI and the GHG Protocol
Calculate a carbon footprint for a sample company
Intern with an ESG firm or a sustainability team
Write an ESG analysis of one listed company
certifications: CFA Institute ESG / Sustainable Investing certificate

roadmaps.overview: A Green Business Associate helps a company cut waste, energy use and emissions and grow sustainable products and services, working across operations, marketing and reporting.
duties: Track energy, water, waste and emissions data
Support green projects: solar, recycling, packaging changes
Help prepare sustainability reports and certifications
Research green markets and customer demand
plan: Learn management, accounting and environmental science
Audit waste and energy at home or college
Study circular economy, ISO 14001 and green building basics
Intern with a sustainability team or green start-up
Run a waste or energy-saving project with measured results

roadmaps.overview: An F&B Service Executive serves guests in hotel restaurants, bars, banquets and room service, making sure food and drink are served well, safely and with great hospitality.
duties: Welcome and serve guests and take orders
Explain the menu, dishes and beverages
plan: Learn F&B service, kitchen and front-office basics
Practise table service, grooming and etiquette
Study menu knowledge, beverages and banquet service
Do your industrial training in a hotel
Learn wine, coffee or mixology basics
Learn POS systems and guest-feedback handling
Apply through campus placements to hotel chains
abroad: Hospitality jobs in the Gulf, Europe and cruise lines; Swiss hospitality programmes

roadmaps.overview: An Archaeologist studies the human past through the things people left behind - sites, tools, pottery, inscriptions and buildings. Archaeologist posts (for example at the Archaeological Survey of India) need a postgraduate degree; a BA in History is the starting point.
workplaces: Archaeological Survey of India and state archaeology departments
plan: Study ancient and medieval Indian history
Visit monuments and museums with notes
Take archaeology or ancient history electives
Learn about excavation methods and dating
Volunteer on an excavation or survey if possible
Do a project on a local site or monument
Apply for MA Archaeology / Ancient History
roadmaps.plan_note: Archaeologist posts need a PG in archaeology or ancient history; ASI's Institute of Archaeology runs a PG Diploma in Archaeology.
certifications: Courses at ASI's Institute of Archaeology

roadmaps.overview: A CAD Designer turns product ideas and sketches into precise 3D models and drawings that factories can make - from appliances and furniture to medical devices and consumer gadgets.
duties: Build 3D models and assemblies from sketches and briefs
Prepare manufacturing drawings with dimensions and tolerances
Create renders and prototypes for reviews
Revise designs with engineers and manufacturers
plan: Learn SolidWorks or Rhino properly, with assemblies
Study manufacturing processes (moulding, sheet metal, CNC)
Intern at a product studio or manufacturer
Learn rendering (KeyShot) and technical drawing standards
Design a product from brief to working prototype
Final project with full CAD data and drawings
Earn a CAD certification and apply

roadmaps.overview: A Brand Designer creates the visual identity of a company or product - logo, colours, typography, packaging and the design system that keeps everything consistent.
duties: Design logos, identity systems and brand guidelines
Apply the brand to packaging, digital and print
Present concepts to clients and refine them
workplaces: In-house brand teams at companies and start-ups
plan: Design 3 complete identities for imaginary brands
Design for a real small business or NGO
Final project: a full brand system with guidelines
Apply to studios and in-house teams

roadmaps.overview: An Assistant Director keeps a film or series shoot organised: schedules, call sheets, continuity and coordination between actors and crew, while learning the craft of directing.
duties: Break down scripts and plan shooting schedules
Prepare call sheets and coordinate actors and crew
Track continuity and keep the set on time
Support the director in rehearsals and post-production
plan: Study film history, grammar and screenwriting basics
Shoot short exercises on a phone
Watch and analyse films every week
Learn camera, sound and editing basics
Assist on ad shoots or student films
Learn scheduling software and call sheets
Final film with a festival plan
Join productions as an AD intern

roadmaps.overview: A Ceramic Designer designs products in clay, porcelain and glass - tableware, tiles, sanitaryware, lighting and art pieces - balancing form, function and how they will be produced.
duties: Design ceramic and glass products and collections
Work with factories on glazes, firing and production
plan: Hand-building and throwing on the wheel
Learn plaster moulds and slip casting
Study clay bodies, glazes and kiln firing
Intern at a ceramics company or craft cluster
Show at design weeks or craft fairs

roadmaps.overview: An Exhibition Designer plans spaces that tell a story - museum galleries, trade-fair stalls, brand experiences and retail displays - combining layout, graphics, lighting and interactive elements.
duties: Plan exhibition layouts and visitor flow
Design displays, graphics, lighting and interactives
plan: Visit museums and trade fairs and sketch layouts
Study visitor flow, lighting and graphics
Design a small exhibition for a college event
Intern with an exhibition or retail design firm
Design a trade-fair stall to budget
Final project: a full museum or brand exhibition
Show drawings, renders and a model
abroad: MA Narrative Environments / Exhibition Design (UK, Europe)

roadmaps.overview: An Information Designer turns data and complex information into clear charts, maps, infographics, dashboards and explainers that people can understand at a glance.
duties: Understand the data and the story it tells
Test with users and improve clarity
plan: Learn basic code (HTML, D3.js or Observable)
Intern with a newsroom or data team
Final project with real public data
Apply to newsrooms, consultancies and product teams
higher: M.Sc Data Science (with a design focus)

roadmaps.overview: A Title Designer creates the opening titles, credits and on-screen text for films, series and ads - animated typography and graphics that set the mood.
duties: Design title sequences and credit styles
Match titles to the film's look with the director and editor
Deliver to broadcast and OTT specifications
plan: Intern at a motion or post-production studio

roadmaps.overview: A Painter / Artist creates original artworks and builds a career through exhibitions, commissions, sales and teaching. It takes a strong personal style, a body of work and persistence.
duties: Create a consistent body of work
Show at exhibitions, art fairs and online
plan: Drawing, colour and composition every day
Explore oil, acrylic, watercolour and mixed media
Start a series around one theme
Apply to group shows and juried exhibitions
Start an online portfolio and Instagram
Final series for the degree show
certifications: Lalit Kala Akademi camps and scholarships
roadmaps.note: Income in the early years is irregular; many artists teach or take commissions alongside.

roadmaps.overview: A Muralist paints large artworks on walls and buildings - for cities, schools, offices, homes and festivals - often working at height and in public.
duties: Design murals for a site and client
Scale up designs and prepare walls
Paint with brushes, rollers and spray
Work safely on scaffolds and lifts
plan: Study Indian and world mural traditions
Paint your first wall (college or community)
Assist a muralist or join a street-art festival
Pitch to cafés, schools and companies

roadmaps.overview: An Art Curator selects and organises artworks into exhibitions and collections, researches them and writes the story that connects them for visitors.
duties: Write catalogues, wall texts and essays
plan: Visit every exhibition you can and write notes
Learn how galleries and museums work
Intern at a gallery, museum or biennale
Curate a larger exhibition with a catalogue
Apply for MA Curatorial Studies / Art History

roadmaps.overview: A Gallery Manager runs the business side of an art gallery: artists, exhibitions, sales, clients, staff and budgets.
duties: Plan the exhibition calendar with artists
Build relationships with collectors and sell work
Handle marketing, events and art fairs
plan: Visit galleries and note how they work
Learn art marketing, pricing and sales
Learn social media and email marketing
Intern at a gallery or art fair
Help run a student exhibition with sales
Learn logistics and insurance of artworks
Build a contact list of artists and buyers
certifications: Art-business short courses (e.g. Sotheby's Institute online)

roadmaps.overview: A Sculptor makes three-dimensional artworks in stone, metal, wood, clay, resin or new materials, for galleries, public spaces and commissions.
duties: Carve, cast, weld or assemble works
plan: Learn carving, casting and welding basics
Final series for the degree show
Apply to residencies and public-art calls

roadmaps.overview: A Public Art Designer creates artworks for public places - roundabouts, parks, metro stations, campuses - that are safe, durable and meaningful to the community.
duties: Respond to public-art briefs and tenders
Design works with engineers for safety and durability
plan: Study public art in your city
Learn metal, stone and resin fabrication
Model a piece for a real site
Work with an engineer on a design
Final public-art proposal with renders and a maquette
Apply to studios and urban design firms
abroad: MA Art in the Public Realm (UK, Europe)

roadmaps.overview: A Restoration Assistant helps conservators clean, repair and protect artworks, sculptures and heritage objects using careful scientific and craft methods.
duties: Document an object's condition with photos and notes
Clean and stabilise objects under supervision
Prepare materials and maintain the lab
plan: Learn chemistry of stone, metal, wood and pigments
Project documenting and treating a sample object

roadmaps.overview: An Advertising Designer creates the visuals for ads - print, outdoor, social media and video - working with copywriters to turn a campaign idea into something people notice.
duties: Adapt designs for every platform and size
Prepare files for print and digital
plan: Collect ads you admire and why
Learn advertising concepts and copy-art teamwork
Make spec campaigns for real brands
Final campaign across print, digital and video

roadmaps.overview: A Layout Artist arranges text and images on pages and screens - magazines, books, packaging, ads - so they are clear, balanced and ready for production.
duties: Lay out pages to a grid and style guide
Place and edit images and text
Prepare files for print and digital
plan: Learn print production, colour and pre-press
Lay out a full magazine issue
Intern at a publisher or agency
Learn digital layouts and social formats
Final project: book or magazine design

roadmaps.overview: A Photojournalist tells news stories through photographs - events, people, conflicts, sport and daily life - for newspapers, agencies and digital media.
duties: Shoot, edit and caption photos accurately
File pictures quickly to the desk
Follow ethics: no staging or misleading edits
plan: Shoot photo stories, not just single images
Intern with a newspaper or agency
Cover local events and file fast

roadmaps.overview: A Photo Editor chooses, edits and plans photos for publications and brands - picking the image that tells the story best and making sure it is accurate and well presented.
duties: Select photos for stories and campaigns
plan: Study picture editing in great magazines
Intern at a publication's photo desk or an agency
Final project editing a full photo story or magazine

roadmaps.overview: A Printmaker creates artworks by printing from plates, blocks and screens - etching, woodcut, lithography and screen-printing - often in editions.
duties: Design and prepare plates, blocks or screens
plan: Work at a community print studio
certifications: Workshops at Garhi studios (Lalit Kala Akademi) or Kanoria Centre for Arts

roadmaps.overview: A Book Designer designs book covers and interiors - typography, layout and production - so books look good, read well and print correctly.
duties: Design covers that sell the book
Lay out interiors with good typography
Work with editors, authors and printers
plan: Final project: a designed and printed book

roadmaps.overview: A Studio Artist works from their own studio, making and selling art - originals, prints and commissions - and often teaching, so the practice becomes a sustainable living.
duties: Sell through galleries, fairs and online
Manage the studio as a small business
plan: Sell a few works or prints

roadmaps.overview: An Art Historian studies art and visual culture through time - who made it, why and what it means - and shares that knowledge through teaching, writing and museum work.
plan: Survey of Indian and world art
Intern at a museum or research centre
Learn a relevant language (Sanskrit, Persian or a European language)
abroad: MA / Ph.D. Art History (UK, US, Europe)

roadmaps.overview: An Art Critic reviews exhibitions and writes about art for magazines, newspapers and online platforms, helping audiences see and judge art thoughtfully.
duties: Follow artists and the art market
plan: Write a short note on each
Apply for writing roles or MA

roadmaps.overview: A Heritage Researcher documents and studies monuments, crafts, traditions and cultural sites, helping protect them and making them known.
duties: Survey and document heritage sites and crafts
plan: Intern with INTACH or a heritage NGO
Document one site or craft fully
Apply for MA Heritage / Art History
higher: MA Heritage Management / Art History / Archaeology

roadmaps.overview: A Ceramic Artist makes original works in clay - functional pottery and sculptural pieces - fired and glazed in their own style, sold through galleries, studios and online.
duties: Sell at fairs, galleries and online

roadmaps.overview: A Craft Designer works with artisans to design products rooted in traditional crafts - handloom, wood, metal, bamboo, pottery - that sell in today's markets while keeping the craft alive.
internships: Craft NGOs (e.g. Dastkar, Crafts Council of India)

roadmaps.overview: A Textile Artist creates art and products with fibre and fabric - weaving, dyeing, embroidery, printing and installation - for galleries, interiors and fashion.
duties: Experiment with dyes, weaves and techniques
Collaborate with weavers, designers and brands

roadmaps.overview: A Studio Entrepreneur turns a craft or art practice into a business - a pottery, textile or art studio that makes and sells products, runs classes and grows a brand.
duties: Sell online, at fairs and through shops
Manage money, staff, GST and marketing
plan: Sell at one fair and online
Learn costing, GST and Udyam registration
Build a brand and online shop
Apply for start-up and MSME support
abroad: Export through craft fairs and online

roadmaps.overview: A Digital Artist creates art on computers and tablets - illustrations, concept art, matte paintings, 3D - for games, films, publishing, ads and their own audience.
duties: Create digital illustrations and concept art
Work to briefs from studios or clients
Build a following and sell work
plan: Final portfolio focused on one industry

roadmaps.overview: An NFT / Digital Collectibles Artist creates digital art sold as tokens on blockchains, often in collections, and builds a community of collectors. It is a young, volatile market.
duties: Mint and list work on marketplaces
Manage wallets, royalties and taxes safely
plan: Understand blockchain, wallets and smart contracts
Build an audience on social platforms
Keep a strong traditional portfolio too
roadmaps.note: In India, gains from virtual digital assets are taxed (30% on gains plus 1% TDS on transfers). Check current rules, and never share wallet keys.

roadmaps.overview: A Motion Artist brings graphics to life - animated logos, explainers, social videos, UI animation and titles - combining design with timing and movement.
duties: Work with designers, editors and clients
plan: Intern at a studio or agency

roadmaps.overview: A Comic Artist tells stories in panels - drawing characters, layouts and action for comics, graphic novels and webcomics.
duties: Write or adapt stories into panels
Work with writers, colourists and editors
Publish in print or online and build readers
plan: Intern with a publisher or studio
Complete a short graphic novel or series

roadmaps.overview: A Children's Book Illustrator draws the pictures that bring children's stories to life - picture books, early readers and educational books.
duties: Read the story and plan illustrations
Work with authors, editors and art directors
plan: Illustrate for StoryWeaver or a small publisher

roadmaps.overview: A Production Designer creates the whole visual world of a film, series or ad - sets, locations, colours and props - and leads the art department to build it.
duties: Design the look of the film with the director and cinematographer
Plan and draw sets and locations
Lead the art department and budget
higher: PG Diploma in Art Direction & Production Design (FTII, SRFTI)

roadmaps.overview: A Props Master finds, makes and manages every object actors use or that appears on screen or stage - and makes sure it is right for the period, safe and in the right place.
duties: Source, buy, hire or build props
Track continuity and props on set
Manage the props team and budget
plan: Build props in wood, foam, resin
higher: PG Diploma in Art Direction (FTII, SRFTI)

roadmaps.overview: A Sub-Editor checks and shapes news before it is published - fixing facts, grammar and length, writing headlines and making stories clear and fair.
duties: Edit reporters' copy for accuracy, clarity and style
Lay out pages or format stories for the web
plan: Master grammar and style in English or your language
Practise editing and headline writing daily
Learn SEO headlines and fact-checking tools

roadmaps.overview: A Digital Journalist reports and publishes news for websites, apps and social media - text, video, graphics and live updates - fast and accurately.
duties: Report and write stories for the web
Make short videos and social posts
Run live blogs and verify viral claims
plan: Learn SEO, social media and analytics
Learn video editing on phone and laptop

roadmaps.overview: A Correspondent reports on a beat or region - politics, courts, business, health, a state or a country - building sources and breaking stories.
plan: Pick a beat you love and read deeply on it
Report local stories for college media
higher: MA in a beat subject (economics, law, politics)

roadmaps.overview: A TV Reporter covers news for television - reporting from the field, doing live pieces to camera and producing packages with camera teams.
duties: Do live reports and pieces to camera
Write scripts and voice-overs for packages
Work with camera and editing teams
plan: Learn to speak clearly in two languages
Report for college TV or YouTube
higher: PG Diploma in Broadcast Journalism (IIMC and others)

roadmaps.overview: A Video Journalist (VJ) reports, shoots and edits video stories alone or in a small team - for TV, digital news and documentaries.
duties: Publish to TV and digital platforms
higher: PG Diploma in Broadcast / Digital Journalism

roadmaps.overview: A TV Producer plans and runs news shows and programmes - choosing stories, guests and running orders, and making sure the show goes out on time.
duties: Run the show from the control room
plan: Learn running orders, rundowns and scripts
Intern in a TV production team
higher: PG Diploma in Broadcast Journalism / TV Production

roadmaps.overview: A News Editor runs the news desk - deciding which stories to cover, assigning reporters, checking copy and making final calls on what is published or aired.
duties: Check copy for accuracy and fairness
plan: Build a portfolio of edited work
roadmaps.plan_note: News Editor is a senior role reached after several years as a reporter or sub-editor.

roadmaps.overview: A Corporate Communications Executive manages how a company talks to the media, employees and the public - press releases, internal news, social media and events.
duties: Write press releases, articles and internal newsletters
plan: Learn how media and PR work
Intern at a PR agency or corporate team
Run communication for a college event

roadmaps.overview: A Media Relations Manager builds relationships with journalists and gets fair, positive coverage for an organisation - and handles the media in a crisis.
duties: Pitch stories and spokespeople to journalists
Prepare press kits and briefing notes
plan: Build a media list and pitch

roadmaps.overview: A Spokesperson speaks for an organisation - to the media, at press conferences and online - explaining its positions clearly and handling tough questions.
roadmaps.plan_note: Spokesperson roles usually come after years in communications or journalism.

roadmaps.overview: A Brand Communication Specialist plans what a brand says and how - campaigns, content, social media and PR - so every message is consistent and builds the brand.
duties: Plan brand campaigns and content calendars
Work with agencies, designers and influencers
plan: Intern with a brand or agency
Run a real campaign for a small brand

roadmaps.overview: An Account Executive in an advertising agency is the link between the client and the agency's creative and media teams - understanding the brief and getting campaigns delivered.
duties: Take client briefs and share them with teams
plan: Learn how briefs, creative and media work

roadmaps.overview: An Audio Journalist reports and tells stories through sound - radio news, podcasts and audio documentaries.
plan: Intern with a podcast studio or radio
higher: PG Diploma in Radio / Broadcast Journalism

roadmaps.overview: An Ayurvedic Drug Manufacturer makes Ayurvedic medicines - churnas, tablets, oils, syrups - safely and to standard, in a licensed factory following Good Manufacturing Practice for Ayurveda (Schedule T).
duties: Source and test herbs and raw materials
Follow Schedule T GMP and the Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia
Handle licences, quality records and audits
plan: Learn the Drugs and Cosmetics Act for ASU drugs
Industrial training in an Ayurvedic factory
Learn Schedule T GMP and documentation
Learn licensing steps for a manufacturing unit
abroad: Herbal and natural-product manufacturing courses; export needs each country's rules
roadmaps.note: Making and selling Ayurvedic medicines needs a manufacturing licence from your state's licensing authority.

roadmaps.overview: A Nursing Officer in government service cares for patients in government hospitals - AIIMS, central and state hospitals, ESIC, Railways and the armed forces - with job security and clear promotion paths.
duties: Work in wards, ICUs, emergency and OTs
Teach patients and supervise junior staff
plan: Child health, mental health and community nursing
Complete internship and register with the State Nursing Council
Prepare for AIIMS NORCET, ESIC and state exams
exams: State PSC / health department nursing exams
Military Nursing Service (via the B.Sc Nursing route)
abroad: Gulf licensing exams; IELTS / OET for English

roadmaps.overview: A Marine Products Export Executive handles the export of fish and seafood - shrimp, fish, squid - from sourcing and processing to quality checks, documents and shipping, meeting the strict rules of buying countries.
duties: Coordinate sourcing and processing with plants
Ensure quality, HACCP and buyer standards
Talk to buyers and track shipments
plan: Fish biology, aquaculture and fishing technology
Learn HACCP and seafood quality standards
Learn export procedures, documentation and MPEDA registration
Study EU, US and Japan import rules
Project on an export product's value chain
Learn Incoterms and letters of credit

roadmaps.overview: An Agri-Start-up Founder builds a business that solves a farming problem - better inputs, market access, farm services, processing or agri-tech - and grows it with customers and investors.
duties: Find a real farmer or market problem
Build and test a product or service
Raise money and build a team
plan: Talk to 20 farmers about their problems
Study agri start-ups that worked and failed
Build a small pilot with real farmers
Join an agri incubator or competition
Learn about RKVY-RAFTAAR and Startup India support
Use RAWE / ELP to test your business
Write a business plan with numbers
Apply for incubation and seed funding

roadmaps.overview: A Nutrition Educator teaches families, schools and communities how to eat well - balanced diets, child and maternal nutrition, anaemia prevention - often through government and NGO programmes.
duties: Assess diets and growth of children and mothers
Create simple education materials in local languages
Support POSHAN Abhiyaan, ICDS and school programmes
plan: Run sessions in a school or village
RAWE / internship with a nutrition programme
Project measuring the impact of a session
roadmaps.note: Becoming a Registered Dietitian needs a PG and the Indian Dietetic Association's process.

roadmaps.overview: A Precision Agriculture Specialist uses sensors, drones, satellite images and data to give each part of a field exactly what it needs - water, fertiliser, spraying - saving cost and raising yields.
duties: Map fields with GPS, drones and satellites
Analyse soil, crop and weather data
plan: Agronomy, soil science and crop physiology
Learn soil testing and nutrient management
Fly drones under supervision; get a DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate
Run a field trial with variable-rate inputs
RAWE / ELP project with measured savings
Build a portfolio of maps and reports

roadmaps.overview: A Farm Data Analyst turns farm data - yields, weather, soil tests, satellite images, market prices - into insights that help farmers, companies and lenders decide better.
duties: Collect and clean farm and weather data
Explain findings to agronomists and managers
plan: Learn remote sensing and weather data
Build a dashboard in Power BI
Intern with an agri-tech or insurer
RAWE / ELP project with farm data

roadmaps.overview: An AgriTech Field Officer works with farmers on the ground for an agri-tech company - signing them up, advising on crops and inputs, and making sure the company's app or service works for them.
duties: Visit farmers and onboard them to the platform
Give crop advice and solve field problems
Support sales of inputs or crop buying
plan: Agronomy, plant protection and soil science
Use agri apps and smartphones well
Intern with an agri-tech field team
Learn basic sales and data entry
Build a list of farmer contacts

roadmaps.overview: An IoT Agri Consultant advises farms, FPOs and companies on which sensor, automation and irrigation technologies to use, sets them up and shows how to use the data.
duties: Assess a farm's needs and budget
plan: Install a sensor system on a farm
Intern with an IoT agri company
RAWE / ELP project with measured savings
higher: M.Sc / M.Tech in Agri-informatics or Soil & Water

roadmaps.overview: An Agri Marketing Officer helps farm produce reach buyers at fair prices - working with mandis (APMCs), eNAM, FPOs, cooperatives and companies on grading, storage and sales.
duties: Support grading, storage and sale of produce
Link FPOs and farmers to buyers and eNAM
workplaces: State agricultural marketing boards and APMCs
plan: Intern with a marketing board or FPO
Analyse price trends for one crop
RAWE / ELP in a market-linked project
Prepare for state agriculture marketing exams

roadmaps.overview: A Cooperative Officer in agriculture works with farmers' cooperatives - credit, dairy, marketing and processing societies - helping them run well and reach markets and credit.
duties: Link societies to credit, inputs and markets
plan: Visit a PACS or dairy society
Intern with a cooperative bank or federation
Prepare for state cooperative department exams

roadmaps.overview: An Agri Credit Officer gives and monitors loans to farmers and agri-businesses - crop loans, Kisan Credit Cards, equipment and allied-activity loans - at banks and NABARD-linked institutions.
duties: Sanction and disburse crop and term loans
plan: Learn crop economics and scale of finance
Learn bank exam reasoning and quant
Intern with a bank's agri branch
RAWE / ELP with a credit project
Write IBPS AFO, NABARD and bank exams

roadmaps.overview: A Seed Quality Analyst tests seed lots for purity, germination, moisture and health, so farmers get good seed and companies meet the Seeds Act and certification standards.
duties: Run germination, purity and moisture tests
plan: Intern in a seed QC lab
Learn the Seeds Act and certification
RAWE / ELP in a seed lab
Project on seed quality of one crop
Apply to seed companies and labs
certifications: Seed testing training (state seed labs / ICAR)

roadmaps.overview: A Plant Breeder Assistant helps breeders develop new crop varieties - planting trials, making crosses, recording traits and managing data - at seed companies and research institutes.
duties: Set up and manage breeding trials
plan: Help in a university breeding trial
Intern with a seed company R&D or ICAR institute
Project on a trait in one crop
Apply for M.Sc Plant Breeding or R&D roles

roadmaps.overview: A Seed Marketing Officer promotes and sells a seed company's varieties to dealers and farmers - demonstrations, field days, dealer networks and farmer advice.
duties: Promote varieties through demos and field days
Advise farmers on varieties and practices
plan: Intern with a seed company sales team
RAWE / ELP in a seed market area

roadmaps.overview: A Dairy Farm Manager runs a dairy farm - animals, feeding, breeding, milking, health, staff and finances - to produce clean milk profitably.
duties: Plan feeding, breeding and health care
Supervise milking and clean milk production
Sell milk and keep the farm profitable
plan: Intern on a commercial dairy farm
RAWE / ELP on a dairy farm
Apply or plan your own unit

roadmaps.overview: A Poultry Manager runs poultry farms or units - broilers, layers or hatcheries - managing birds' health, feed, biosecurity, staff and production targets.
duties: Track growth, egg production and mortality
plan: RAWE / ELP on a poultry unit
Write a farm plan with costs

roadmaps.overview: An Animal Husbandry Officer supports livestock farmers - cattle, buffaloes, goats, poultry - with breeding, feeding, disease prevention and government livestock schemes.
duties: Advise farmers on breeding, feeding and housing
plan: Check your state's eligibility and prepare for exams
Apply to dairy and livestock projects
exams: State PSC livestock / animal husbandry posts (check eligibility)
roadmaps.note: Government Animal Husbandry / Veterinary Officer posts usually need a B.V.Sc & A.H.; with this degree, look at livestock extension and development posts and check each state's rules.

roadmaps.overview: A Feed Nutritionist designs feed for dairy cattle, poultry or fish - balancing nutrients and cost - and helps farmers feed animals for health and productivity.
duties: Track animal performance on the feed
plan: Intern at a feed mill or QC lab
RAWE / ELP with a feed company

roadmaps.overview: A Watershed Officer plans and implements watershed projects - check dams, contour trenches, ponds, tree planting - that save soil and water and raise farm incomes in a whole village area.
workplaces: State watershed and rural development departments (PMKSY-WDC)
plan: Intern with a watershed NGO or project
RAWE / ELP in a watershed village
exams: State PSC agriculture / soil conservation posts

roadmaps.overview: A Soil Conservation Officer protects farmland from erosion and degradation - planning bunds, terraces, check dams and soil-health programmes for government soil conservation departments.
workplaces: State soil conservation and agriculture departments
plan: Visit eroded areas and conservation works
Soil testing and Soil Health Cards
Intern with a soil conservation department or IISWC
Prepare for state PSC agriculture / soil conservation posts
higher: M.Sc Soil Science / Soil & Water Conservation

roadmaps.overview: An Irrigation Consultant designs and advises on efficient irrigation - drip, sprinkler and scheduling - so farms use less water and get better yields.
duties: Assess farm water sources, soils and crops
plan: Irrigation engineering and crop water needs
Design a system for a real farm
Learn PMKSY Per Drop More Crop
RAWE / ELP with an irrigation project

roadmaps.overview: An NGO Field Officer works directly with village communities on projects - water, farming livelihoods, women's groups, health or education - turning plans into results on the ground.
certifications: Development fellowships (e.g. state and corporate fellowships)

roadmaps.overview: An Agri Processing Manager runs a unit that turns farm produce into products - flour, pulses, spices, oil, juices, dehydrated foods - with good quality, safety and margins.
A Cold Storage Manager runs cold stores and pack-houses that keep fruits, vegetables, potatoes and other produce fresh - managing temperature, stock, customers and costs.
duties: Control temperature, humidity and storage conditions
plan: Intern in a cold store or pack-house
RAWE / ELP with a cold-chain unit

roadmaps.overview: A Food Quality Officer makes sure food is safe and meets standards - testing raw materials and products, running HACCP systems and preparing for FSSAI and buyer audits.
duties: Test raw materials and finished products
Keep quality records and handle audits
workplaces: FSSAI and state food safety departments
plan: Food safety, standards and FSSAI rules
Intern in a QC lab or plant
RAWE / ELP in a food unit
Prepare for Food Safety Officer exams
higher: M.Sc / M.Tech Food Technology / Food Safety
exams: FSSAI / state Food Safety Officer exams

roadmaps.overview: A Herbal Farm Manager grows medicinal and aromatic plants - ashwagandha, tulsi, lemongrass, mint - managing cultivation, quality, harvest and sale to herbal and pharma companies.
duties: Plan cultivation of medicinal and aromatic crops
Follow good agricultural and collection practices
plan: Cultivation of medicinal and aromatic plants
Intern with a herbal farm or CSIR-CIMAP
RAWE / ELP on a herbal farm
Write a farm business plan (NMPB support)
Apply or plan your own farm

roadmaps.overview: A Floriculturist grows and markets flowers and ornamental plants - roses, gerbera, marigold, orchids - often in polyhouses, for weddings, events, export and landscaping.
duties: Plan flower crops and growing structures
Sell to markets, florists and exporters
plan: Intern on a flower farm or with ICAR-DFR
Grow a crop in a polyhouse
Write a polyhouse business plan (NHB support)

roadmaps.overview: A Landscape Gardener designs, plants and maintains gardens and green spaces - homes, offices, hotels, parks and campuses.
plan: Design and install a small garden
Apply or start a landscaping business

roadmaps.overview: A Nursery Owner raises and sells plants - fruit saplings, vegetables seedlings, ornamentals, forestry plants - to farmers, gardeners and government schemes.
duties: Sell to farmers, gardeners and schemes

roadmaps.overview: A Herbal Product Executive works in a herbal or Ayurvedic company on sourcing, product development, quality or marketing of herbal products.
duties: Source and check herbal raw materials
plan: RAWE / ELP with a herbal unit
Project on a herbal value chain

roadmaps.overview: A Hydroponics Farm Manager runs farms that grow crops without soil - in nutrient water inside greenhouses or indoor setups - producing lettuce, herbs, tomatoes and more for cities.
duties: Manage nutrient solutions, pH and EC
plan: Build a small home hydroponic kit
RAWE / ELP on a hydroponic farm

roadmaps.overview: A Vertical Farm Technician keeps indoor vertical farms running - LED lighting, nutrient systems, sensors and crop care - so stacked trays of greens grow evenly all year.
duties: Monitor and adjust nutrients, lighting and climate
plan: RAWE / ELP at an indoor farm

roadmaps.overview: A Natural Farming Consultant helps farmers shift to natural and organic farming - using local inputs like jeevamrit, mulching and crop diversity - cutting costs and chemicals while keeping yields.
duties: Link farmers to buyers of natural produce
plan: Learn the National Mission on Natural Farming
Intern with an NGO or FPO doing natural farming
certifications: Natural / organic farming training (e.g. NCONF, MANAGE)

roadmaps.overview: An AgriPreneur runs a farm-based business - natural produce, hydroponics, value-added foods, agri-inputs or farm services - selling directly to customers and markets.
duties: Sell through markets, online or contracts
plan: Pick a product and test demand
Run a small pilot and sell
Learn about AC&ABC, PMFME and RKVY-RAFTAAR support
RAWE / ELP to build the business

roadmaps.overview: A Tractor Service Engineer diagnoses and repairs tractors and farm machinery, trains dealer mechanics and handles warranty and service for a tractor company or dealer.
duties: Diagnose and repair tractors and implements
Handle warranty claims and service camps
plan: Intern with a tractor company or dealer
Training at FMTTI Budni if possible

roadmaps.overview: An Agri Equipment Sales Engineer sells tractors, implements, irrigation and harvesting machines - explaining the technology to dealers and farmers and helping them choose and finance the right machine.
duties: Promote machines through demos and field days
plan: Intern with a machinery company sales team

roadmaps.overview: A Chartered Accountant in practice runs their own firm or partners in one, offering audit, tax, GST, accounting and advisory services to businesses and individuals. Only a practising CA (with ICAI's Certificate of Practice) can sign statutory audits.
duties: File income tax and GST returns and represent clients
Advise on accounts, tax planning and compliance
Build and manage a team and client base
plan: Build strong accounting and business-law basics
Study accounting standards, tax and audit closely
Complete ICAI's IT and soft-skills courses
Choose a firm with audit and tax exposure
Work on audits, returns and client files
Note how the partner runs the practice
Clear CA Final and become a member
Start small: tax, GST and audits for local businesses
roadmaps.plan_note: Follow ICAI's current scheme for exams, articleship length and course requirements.
certifications: ICAI post-qualification courses (e.g. DISA, FAFD, GST)
abroad: Mutual recognition with some bodies (e.g. ICAEW, CPA Australia) - check current agreements

roadmaps.overview: A Statutory Auditor checks a company's financial statements every year, as the law requires, and gives an independent opinion on whether they are true and fair.
duties: Plan and carry out the annual audit
Issue the audit report under the Companies Act
plan: Focus on auditing and accounting standards
Work on statutory and bank audits
Join an audit team or start practice
roadmaps.plan_note: Only a practising CA (or a CA firm) can be appointed statutory auditor of a company.
abroad: ACCA / CPA for international audit roles

roadmaps.overview: A Chief Financial Officer leads a company's finances - planning, funding, reporting, risk and investor relations - and is one of the top decision-makers. It is reached after 15 years or more in finance.
duties: Raise funds and manage cash and capital
Advise the CEO and board on major decisions
plan: Read business news and annual reports
Get audit plus tax and advisory exposure
Start in audit, FP&A or controllership
Move across roles to build all-round finance experience
roadmaps.plan_note: CFO is a leadership role, usually reached after 15-20 years across reporting, FP&A, treasury and business finance.
abroad: Global finance roles; ACCA / CPA can help

roadmaps.overview: A Finance Controller runs a company's accounting and reporting - month-end closing, financial statements, budgets, controls and audits.
duties: Lead the monthly and yearly close
Prepare financial statements under Ind AS
Manage budgets, variance analysis and MIS
Run internal controls and coordinate audits
plan: Learn the closing process at clients
Start as an accountant or reporting executive

roadmaps.overview: An Investment Banker helps companies raise money (IPOs, debt) and buy or merge with other companies, doing valuation, deal work and negotiations.
duties: Prepare pitch books and offer documents
Run due diligence and deal processes
Work with clients, lawyers and regulators
plan: Start CFA Level I if you can
Try for a firm with transaction or valuation work
abroad: MBA or MSc Finance (UK, US) for global IB roles

roadmaps.overview: A Forensic Auditor investigates fraud and financial wrongdoing - following the money, finding evidence and reporting for courts, regulators and companies.
duties: Write reports and support legal cases
plan: Try for forensic or bank-audit work
certifications: ICAI FAFD (Forensic Accounting and Fraud Detection)

roadmaps.overview: A Corporate Governance Manager makes sure a company's board and management follow the law and good governance - board meetings, disclosures, ethics and shareholder rights.
duties: Run board and committee meetings and minutes
Ensure Companies Act and SEBI LODR compliance
plan: Learn company law and SEBI basics
Study secretarial standards and governance codes
Work on board meetings and filings
roadmaps.plan_note: Follow ICSI's current scheme for exams and training.

roadmaps.overview: A Registrar & Transfer Agent (RTA) keeps a listed company's or fund's record of shareholders - share transfers, dematerialisation, dividends and investor requests - as a SEBI-registered intermediary.
duties: Process transfers, demat and corporate actions
plan: Study SEBI rules on RTAs and depositories
Train with an RTA or company secretarial team
certifications: NISM Series II-A (Registrars to an Issue and Share Transfer Agents - Corporate)

roadmaps.overview: A Cost Accountant measures and controls what it costs to make products and run services, helping managers set prices, cut waste and plan budgets.
duties: Advise on pricing and cost reduction
plan: Cost accounting and Cost Accounting Standards
Visit a factory to see costs in action
roadmaps.plan_note: Follow ICMAI's current scheme for exams and training.
abroad: CMA (US) or CIMA for global roles

roadmaps.overview: A Cost Auditor audits the cost records of companies that must keep them under the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, and reports to the board and government.
duties: Check compliance with cost rules and standards
plan: Learn cost rules under the Companies Act
Complete training and take the Certificate of Practice
Join or start a cost-audit practice
roadmaps.plan_note: Only a cost accountant in practice can be appointed cost auditor.

roadmaps.overview: A Management Accountant gives managers the numbers they need to decide - budgets, forecasts, product profitability, MIS reports and business cases.
plan: Join an FP&A or business finance team

roadmaps.overview: A Financial Controller (from the CMA route) leads accounting, costing and reporting - month-end close, cost control, budgets and audits - for a company or plant.
plan: Move into controllership over the years

roadmaps.overview: An International Auditor audits companies under international standards (ISA, IFRS, US GAAP) - often for global clients from India's Big 4 and audit delivery centres, or abroad.
duties: Audit financial statements under ISA / PCAOB standards
Work with global audit teams across time zones
Document work to international quality standards
roadmaps.plan_note: ACCA needs 3 years of relevant experience (PER); CPA US needs credit hours and state licensing - check current rules.
abroad: Audit roles in the UK, Gulf, Australia, US

roadmaps.overview: A Group Reporting Manager prepares the consolidated accounts of a group of companies - combining subsidiaries, eliminating inter-company items and reporting under IFRS or Ind AS.
duties: Run group consolidation each month and year
Apply IFRS / Ind AS to complex items
abroad: Group reporting roles in the UK, Europe, Gulf

roadmaps.overview: An Audit Manager leads audit engagements - planning, managing teams, reviewing work and handling clients - in an audit firm or a company's internal audit function.
duties: Lead and review the audit team
Sign off files for partner review
plan: Clear the final papers and PER

roadmaps.overview: A Tax Manager plans and manages taxes for companies or clients - corporate tax, international tax, transfer pricing and compliance - in firms, companies or global tax centres.
duties: Advise on tax planning and structures
Handle transfer pricing and international tax
abroad: Tax roles in the UK, US, Gulf

roadmaps.overview: A Risk Manager finds, measures and controls risks - credit, market, liquidity and operational - for banks, insurers, funds and companies.
duties: Measure risks with models and data
Report risks to management and regulators
plan: Clear FRM Part I (or CFA Level I)
Learn Basel norms and RBI risk rules
Specialise in credit, market or operational risk
roadmaps.plan_note: FRM needs two years of relevant work experience to be certified.
abroad: Risk roles globally; FRM is recognised widely

roadmaps.overview: A Portfolio Manager decides how to invest money for clients or a fund - choosing stocks, bonds and other assets - to meet goals within risk limits.
plan: Complete work experience for the charter
roadmaps.plan_note: SEBI sets qualification and experience rules for PMS principal officers - check the current regulations.
abroad: Fund roles globally with the CFA charter

roadmaps.overview: An Actuary uses maths, statistics and finance to price insurance and pensions and to measure long-term financial risk. Fellowship of the Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI) is the professional qualification.
duties: Advise on product design and regulation
plan: Clear core subjects (CS, CM, CB series)
Intern with an insurer or consultancy
Progress to Associate and then Fellow
roadmaps.plan_note: Qualifying usually takes several years of exams alongside work.
certifications: IAI (Institute of Actuaries of India) exams
abroad: Actuarial roles in the UK, US, Australia via IFoA / SOA

roadmaps.overview: A Junior Developer writes and fixes code for websites, apps and business software as part of a team, learning fast on real projects.
duties: Write and test code for features
Work with Git and code reviews
Learn the team's tools and practices
plan: Learn one language well (JavaScript or Python)
Publish projects on GitHub and apply
roadmaps.plan_note: B.Voc allows exits with a Diploma (1 year) or Advanced Diploma (2 years) - keep building projects either way.

roadmaps.overview: A Technical Assistant supports an organisation's IT - setting up computers and accounts, fixing problems, managing software and helping users.
duties: Set up computers, printers and networks
plan: Intern in an IT support team
abroad: IT support roles in the Gulf

roadmaps.overview: A Retail Sales Executive helps customers in a store choose and buy products - from phones to clothes to electronics - and meets sales targets.
duties: Keep the store and displays in order
plan: Earn a retail sector skill certificate
certifications: Retailers Association's Skill Council of India (RASCI) qualifications

roadmaps.overview: An Inventory Manager makes sure a store or warehouse has the right stock at the right time - not too much, not too little - and that stock records match reality.
duties: Run stock counts and fix differences
plan: On-the-job training in a store or warehouse
Apply to retail and warehouse roles

roadmaps.overview: A Customer Experience Executive makes sure customers have a good experience in-store and after - handling queries, complaints, feedback and loyalty.
duties: Answer customer questions in store, phone or chat
plan: Communication in English and local language
Apply to retail and CX roles

roadmaps.overview: A Loan Executive sources and processes loans - personal, home, vehicle, business or gold loans - for banks and NBFCs, from meeting customers to disbursement.
duties: Follow up for disbursement and repayment
plan: On-the-job training at a bank or NBFC
exams: IBPS / SBI clerk and PO exams

roadmaps.overview: A Financial Services Executive helps customers with banking, insurance and investment products - opening accounts, selling policies and funds, and servicing requests.
plan: Clear NISM V-A and the IRDAI agent exam if selling these

roadmaps.overview: A Guest Relations Executive welcomes guests at hotels, resorts and airports, handles their requests and complaints and makes sure their stay is memorable.
duties: Coordinate with front office and other departments
plan: Earn a Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council certificate
abroad: Hotel jobs in the Gulf and cruise lines

roadmaps.overview: A Health Assistant supports doctors and nurses in clinics, hospitals and community programmes - checking vitals, assisting procedures, keeping records and helping patients.
duties: Check vitals and assist in examinations
Support health camps and community programmes
plan: Earn a Healthcare Sector Skill Council certificate
abroad: Care assistant roles abroad (with language tests)

roadmaps.overview: A Patient Care Coordinator guides patients through their hospital journey - appointments, admissions, insurance, discharge and follow-up - so care is smooth and nothing is missed.
duties: Coordinate between patients, doctors and departments
Help with insurance and billing queries
plan: Training in a hospital front office

roadmaps.overview: A Medical Records Assistant keeps patient records complete, accurate and private - filing, digitising, coding and retrieving records for doctors, billing and insurance.
plan: Training in a medical records department
Apply to hospitals and coding firms
certifications: Medical coding certificates (AAPC CPC, AHIMA CCS)

roadmaps.overview: A Procurement Assistant helps buy what a company needs - raw materials, parts, services - getting quotes, raising purchase orders and tracking deliveries.
plan: On-the-job training in a purchase team
Earn a Logistics Skill Council certificate

roadmaps.overview: A Beauty Consultant advises customers on skincare, makeup and beauty products, gives demos and sells - at beauty stores, brand counters and salons.
duties: Keep the counter and stock in order
plan: On-the-job training at a counter or salon
Earn a Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council certificate
certifications: Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council qualifications
abroad: Beauty retail and salon jobs in the Gulf

roadmaps.overview: A Retail Fashion Executive sells clothing and accessories in fashion stores - styling customers, managing displays and helping the store meet sales targets.
plan: On-the-job training in a fashion store
higher: Fashion retail / merchandising courses (NIFT and others)

roadmaps.overview: An EV Technician services and repairs electric vehicles - two-wheelers, three-wheelers and cars - including batteries, motors, controllers and charging systems, safely.
plan: On-the-job training at an EV service centre
Earn an ASDC EV qualification and apply
certifications: Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) EV qualifications
higher: Diploma / B.Tech lateral routes in EV technology

roadmaps.overview: A Charging Station Operator runs EV charging stations - keeping chargers working, helping drivers, handling payments and making sure the site is safe.
duties: Monitor chargers and fix basic faults
Help drivers start and pay for charging

roadmaps.overview: A Leather Designer designs leather products - bags, footwear, belts, jackets and accessories - choosing leathers, patterns and construction for brands and exporters.
plan: Intern with a leather brand or exporter

roadmaps.overview: A Cargo Manager runs air-cargo operations at an airline, airport or cargo terminal - acceptance, documentation, security, dangerous goods, loading and customs coordination.
duties: Ensure safety, security and dangerous-goods rules
Plan capacity and loading with airlines
plan: Intern at a cargo terminal or forwarder
exams: Customs Broker licensing exam (for clearance careers)
abroad: Cargo roles at Gulf and Asian hubs

roadmaps.overview: A Service Technician maintains and repairs vehicles - cars, diesel vehicles, two-wheelers and increasingly EVs - at dealer workshops and service centres.
duties: Explain work to service advisors and customers
plan: On-the-job training and the trade test

roadmaps.overview: A Hair Stylist cuts, colours, styles and treats hair in salons, studios and on sets, building a loyal clientele and a recognisable style.
duties: Keep tools and the station hygienic
certifications: Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council qualifications
